/.title: 4PLANET_ — See the Living Planet
/.description: Explore life, planetary data and the systems that connect us — from the whole Earth to a species, place or mission.
/.imageAlt: The living planet seen through a storm system from space.

/atlas.title: ATLAS_ — Explore the Living Planet
/atlas.description: Move from the whole Earth to places, species, observations and planetary signals — with sources and limitations visible.
/atlas.imageAlt: Earth seen from orbit above the curved horizon.

/species.title: SPECIES_ — Meet Life on Earth
/species.description: Start with a species. Follow where it lives, what it depends on and the evidence behind what we know.

/living-systems.title: LIVING SYSTEMS_ — See What Life Depends On
/living-systems.description: Follow the relationships between species, places, climate and people — one connected living system at a time.
/living-systems.imageAlt: A living forest viewed as one connected system.

/impact.title: IMPACT_ — From Understanding to Credible Action
/impact.description: See how 4PLANET is building transparent pathways from participation to delivery, evidence and proof.
/impact.imageAlt: A living landscape representing the path from understanding to action.

/missions.title: MISSIONS_ — What 4PLANET Is Building
/missions.description: Explore the first 4PLANET missions across ocean, land, human systems and culture — with current status made explicit.
/missions.imageAlt: The living planet seen from space.

/domains.title: 4PLANET DOMAINS_ — Four Ways Into One Living Planet
/domains.description: Enter OCE4N_, E4RTH_, S4PIENS_ and 4CULTURE_ — four connected views of one living planet.
/domains.imageAlt: Earth rising above a dark horizon.

/domains/oce4n.title: OCE4N_ — Enter the Living Ocean
/domains/oce4n.description: Explore ocean life, pressures, relationships and missions through the 4PLANET ocean domain.
/domains/oce4n.imageAlt: The open ocean as a living system.

/domains/e4rth.title: E4RTH_ — Enter the Living Land
/domains/e4rth.description: Explore forests, climate, biodiversity and restoration through the 4PLANET land domain.

/domains/s4piens.title: S4PIENS_ — See the Human Systems Shaping Earth
/domains/s4piens.description: Explore food, energy, cities and fashion as human systems embedded in the living planet.
/domains/s4piens.imageAlt: Human systems meeting the landscapes that sustain them.

/domains/4culture.title: 4CULTURE_ — Change What We Notice
/domains/4culture.description: Explore film, art, stories and play as cultural ways to see and reconnect with the living planet.
/domains/4culture.imageAlt: Culture and creativity in relationship with the living planet.

/missions/wh4les.title: WH4LES_ — Follow the Living Ocean
/missions/wh4les.description: Meet whales through life, place, relationships and source-aware evidence — then follow the systems around them.
/missions/wh4les.imageAlt: Whale life in the open ocean.

/missions/cor4l.title: COR4L_ — Enter the Reef
/missions/cor4l.description: See coral reefs as living systems shaped by heat, habitat, species relationships and human pressure.
/missions/cor4l.imageAlt: A coral reef alive with marine life.

/missions/cle4n.title: CLE4N_ — Rethink Plastic in a Living Ocean
/missions/cle4n.description: Trace plastic pressure through ocean systems and the evidence needed to move from concern to credible response.
/missions/cle4n.imageAlt: Ocean and coast shaped by the problem of plastic pollution.

/missions/rewild-marine.title: RE:WILD_ MARINE — Bring Coastal Life Back
/missions/rewild-marine.description: Explore what marine restoration can mean when place, species, evidence and delivery are kept connected.
/missions/rewild-marine.imageAlt: A coastal ecosystem with space for marine life to recover.

/missions/clim4te.title: CLIM4TE_ — Read a Changing Planet
/missions/clim4te.description: Explore climate signals in context — what the source establishes, what remains uncertain and what connects next.
/missions/clim4te.imageAlt: A planetary climate landscape in transition.

/missions/am4zonia.title: AM4ZONIA_ — Enter a Living System
/missions/am4zonia.description: See the Amazon through forest, water, climate, species and people — connected rather than reduced to one metric.
/missions/am4zonia.imageAlt: The Amazon rainforest as a vast living system.

/missions/species.title: SPECIES_ MISSION — Make Life Visible
/missions/species.description: Explore how 4PLANET connects species identity, observations, habitats, relationships and source-aware understanding.

/missions/rewild-land.title: RE:WILD_ LAND — Make Space for Life
/missions/rewild-land.description: Explore land restoration through habitats, species, ecological relationships and evidence-backed possibilities.
/missions/rewild-land.imageAlt: A terrestrial ecosystem recovering space for life.

/missions/food.title: FOOD_ — See What Your Food Depends On
/missions/food.description: Follow food choices back through ingredients, land, water, pollination, climate and the systems behind them.
/missions/food.imageAlt: Food connected to the living systems that make it possible.

/missions/en4rgy.title: EN4RGY_ — See the System Behind the Switch
/missions/en4rgy.description: Explore the infrastructure, emissions and dependencies behind energy — with source and time kept visible.
/missions/en4rgy.imageAlt: Energy infrastructure within a wider landscape.

/missions/circular-city.title: CIRCULAR CITY_ — Redesign the Urban Metabolism
/missions/circular-city.description: See a city through materials, energy, food, waste and nature — then explore where circular systems can change the flow.
/missions/circular-city.imageAlt: A city understood through the flows that sustain it.

/missions/f4shion.title: F4SHION_ — Follow What We Wear Back to Earth
/missions/f4shion.description: Trace clothing through fibres, materials, water, land, labour and waste — beyond the finished product.
/missions/f4shion.imageAlt: Fashion materials connected back to land and production.

/missions/m4gazine.title: M4GAZINE_ — Stories for a Living Planet
/missions/m4gazine.description: Enter 4PLANET’s editorial world: stories that connect species, places, people, systems, solutions and culture.
/missions/m4gazine.imageAlt: Editorial storytelling for a living planet.

/missions/4film.title: 4FILM_ — Watch the Living Planet
/missions/4film.description: Film and documentary as a way to see ecological reality, human choices and living systems with greater depth.
/missions/4film.imageAlt: Documentary film focused on the living planet.

/missions/4rt.title: 4RT_ — Prints for Planet
/missions/4rt.description: Art, photography and design connected to 4PLANET missions through a transparent cultural and impact pathway.
/missions/4rt.imageAlt: Art and photography created in relationship with the living planet.

/missions/4play.title: 4PLAY_ — Make the Living Planet Playable
/missions/4play.description: Explore play as a way to understand living systems, ecological relationships and the choices inside them.
/missions/4play.imageAlt: Play and interaction inspired by the living planet.

/species/orca.title: ORCA_ — Meet Orcinus orca
/species/orca.description: Meet the orca through identity, observations, relationships and evidence — without turning a map record into a live animal.
/species/orca.imageAlt: Whale life at the ocean surface.

/species/humpback-whale.title: HUMPBACK WHALE_ — Meet Megaptera novaeangliae
/species/humpback-whale.description: Meet the humpback whale through source-aware identity, observations, habitat and the living systems around it.
/species/humpback-whale.imageAlt: Whale life at the ocean surface.

/species/sperm-whale.title: SPERM WHALE_ — Meet Physeter macrocephalus
/species/sperm-whale.description: Meet the sperm whale through source-aware identity, deep-ocean habitat, observations and ecological context.
/species/sperm-whale.imageAlt: Whale life in the open ocean.

/species/western-honey-bee.title: WESTERN HONEY BEE_ — Follow a Pollinator
/species/western-honey-bee.description: Meet Apis mellifera and follow the links between pollination, flowering plants, food and human-managed landscapes.
/species/western-honey-bee.imageAlt: Pollination and food within a living landscape.

/living-systems/orca.title: ORCA_ — A Living System, Not a Dot on a Map
/living-systems/orca.description: Follow an orca from observation record to prey, habitat, pressure and uncertainty through one guided living-system journey.
/living-systems/orca.imageAlt: Whale life within a connected ocean system.

/living-systems/amazonia.title: AMAZONIA_ — See the Forest as a Living System
/living-systems/amazonia.description: Follow forest, water, climate, species and people through one connected Amazonia journey.
/living-systems/amazonia.imageAlt: The Amazon rainforest seen as a connected living system.

/living-systems/oslofjord.title: OSLOFJORD_ — See a Fjord as a Living System
/living-systems/oslofjord.description: Explore Oslofjord through place, species, source records, pressures and what the current evidence can establish.
/living-systems/oslofjord.imageAlt: A coastal marine landscape representing a living fjord system.

/living-systems/great-barrier-reef.title: GREAT BARRIER REEF_ — Enter the Reef System
/living-systems/great-barrier-reef.description: Explore a reef through habitat, heat, species relationships and source-aware planetary data.
/living-systems/great-barrier-reef.imageAlt: A coral reef seen as a connected living system.

/join.title: JOIN 4PLANET_ — Find Your Way In
/join.description: Follow the build, contribute expertise, participate creatively or explore a future partnership with 4PLANET.
/join.imageAlt: People participating in work connected to the living planet.

/people.title: 4PEOPLE_ — Participate in 4PLANET
/people.description: Explore ways for people to follow, test, contribute expertise and take part as 4PLANET develops.
/people.imageAlt: People participating in work connected to the living planet.

/brands.title: 4BRANDS_ — Build Better With the Living Planet
/brands.description: Explore how brands may contribute data, capability, distribution or support without buying influence over ecological truth.

/partners.title: 4PARTNERS_ — Build the System Together

/funders.title: 4FUNDERS_ — Fund What Can Be Proven
/funders.description: Explore early funding pathways for 4PLANET’s shared infrastructure, public intelligence and bounded proof projects.
/funders.imageAlt: Earth above the horizon, representing the scale of the shared mission.

/actors.title: ACTORS_ — Who Can Move a Living System
/actors.description: Explore organisations, institutions and people through their potential roles in ecological action and shared planetary intelligence.

/get-involved.description: Find a practical entry into 4PLANET through expertise, data, creativity, partnership, testing or support.

/reports.title: REPORTS_ — Evidence, Status and What Comes Next
/reports.description: Explore 4PLANET reporting surfaces for current status, evidence, limitations and progress without inflated claims.

/about.title: ABOUT 4PLANET_ — Why This Exists
/about.description: Understand the purpose, product family and principles behind 4PLANET — a system for seeing, understanding and acting for a living planet.

/about/story.title: THE STORY_ — Why 4PLANET Exists
/about/story.description: The human and ecological story behind 4PLANET, from lived experience to a system designed for a living planet.
